reviews.text: They are competent and professional, and on more than one occasion they have immediately found both the cause and the cure. Their unconditional love for animals shines through in everything they do, making the visit less traumatic for your pets.

Let me briefly tell you about my experience: I've had a cat for two years, her first kitten. I don't understand why she keeps vomiting, even though my previous vets kept saying it was hairballs.
At the very first visit, they immediately realized she had gastritis, stomatitis, and a bit constipated.
They immediately directed us to the right specialists and gave us the perfect treatment.
It's clear they have a passion and love for the animals they treat, and they're always available to explain the treatments to their owners.
I feel compelled to recommend them to you!
Every time I bring my cats, the vets are super attentive and, above all, professional. Excellent service, very satisfied.

After 11 years of experience with them, which unfortunately ended abruptly, Dr. Clara Macchi should learn a little more humility. She lacks it, having treated us badly and telling me over the phone that she was happy we were finally no longer going to them, even though she had declared me a dermatologist, and I refused to take my dog ​​to another dermatologist because she preferred it that way. This is just one of many episodes. I hope I never have anything to share again; we've found a veterinarian who truly loves animals, not just bills. I wish them the best of luck.

We went to this veterinary clinic for the first time with our 18-year-old cat Chicco. The two doctors were truly extraordinary in understanding what was wrong with our furry friend. A thorough check-up was carried out, and he finally let his nails be trimmed. He even had his bottom pricked and weighed, and was petted. But he also wanted to be cuddled by a human other than one of us. We'll be back on Wednesday for more tests. We left feeling satisfied and happy, but above all, we found them to be very competent and do their job with love. Good.

After reading the excellent reviews since I moved, I brought my cat Elsa to meet her and have a checkup. The welcome and kindness of both doctors was excellent; they identified her weaknesses and treated her as best as possible. Very kind and helpful. Highly recommended!
Excellent experience, very thorough, approved by my cat, who is not an easy type, with them he remains calm.

I took my cat to the clinic after reading the numerous reviews on Google, and I must say I was amazed by the kindness, thoroughness, empathy, affection, and professionalism of the doctors. They were curious to know my cat's history, and they took an interest in her health and habits, without any rush, but with the pleasure of learning and doing their job well. I'm so happy and comforted to have found them, so close to my home, that I can't explain it!

I recommend everyone to entrust their pets to Doctors Giorgio and Clara!
A solid practice with two very kind and patient owners. I've been going there for a couple of years because I adopted a 5-year-old cat from the SOS Stray Association.

Dr. Giorgio and Dr. Clara assisted my Billy in his final moments before he fell asleep forever. They combined professional expertise
with tenderness, loving kindness for him, and understanding for my grief, making the separation, despite the desperation of the moment, peaceful. Thank you so much.
The clinic is clean and tidy, and the vets are competent, helpful, and kind, both to patients and owners. I highly recommend it.

The doctors are meticulous in their patient care, dedicating time and attention to them. They were helpful and understanding with me, and affectionate with my dog ​​and truly interested in his well-being. It's clear they love their work! I can highly recommend you to everyone.
